## Pull request overview

This PR aims to fix authentication/session-related failures affecting “Torre de Control” API routes and ensure `remittanceNumber` is persisted when updating sale orders.

- Adds a new proxy/middleware entrypoint intended to refresh Supabase sessions (JWT) before RLS rejects requests.

- Threads `remittanceNumber` through `UpdateSaleOrderInput` and sale update payloads, with a separate post-RPC update to `sales_orders.remittance_number`.
